summary: The only source is an Eastern US Lookouts stub that places a Bakersville lookout in Saint Johns County; no tower record or site description found.
notes_for_editor: The only source is the Eastern US Lookouts stub, which gives county only. Two web searches and one page read found no tower history, no Florida Forest Service record and no Wikipedia community page (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bakersville,_Florida returns 404). An undated wildfire report about 675 acres in southwest St. Johns County mentions no tower and is left out. The story is about 25 words, far under the 120-word floor. Recommend holding it or leaving the record as unknown.
